data.name: Zombase
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Zombase is a zombie survival game where your base has wheels, propellers, weapons, and a very real chance of crashing.

The safe zone is moving, the horde is coming, and your only option is to build something ridiculous enough to get you there.

Build the Escape Base

Turn your base into a flying fortress, a rolling death trap, or a barely working pile of junk with engines attached.

If it moves, it might save you.

If it crashes, good luck.

Kill Zombies, Upgrade Everything

No chopping trees. No punching rocks.

Kill zombies to earn resources, then use them to upgrade your base, weapons, traps, engines, wheels, propellers, and defenses.

Reach the Safe Zone

Every run is about getting further.

Build, launch, crash, rebuild, and try again until your base can survive the journey.

Solo or Online Co-op

Play alone or with friends online.

Build together, defend together, escape together, and blame each other when the base explodes.

data.short_description: Zombase is a co-op zombie survival game where your base is your escape plan. Build wheels, propellers, weapons, and traps onto your mobile base, then fight through the horde and try to reach the safe zone without crashing.
